records.typical_characteristics: New to structured training or low skill/consistency
records.programming_priorities: 2–3 sessions/week; simple full-body plan; stable movements; low-to-moderate volume; learn technique; easy progression
records.avoid: Complex periodisation, frequent max testing, excessive exercise variety

records.typical_characteristics: Consistent training history; progress slower; understands core lifts
records.programming_priorities: Individualise volume, split, exercise selection; use RIR/RPE; monitor performance; planned variation where useful
records.avoid: Assuming more days/sets automatically means better

records.typical_characteristics: Long training history; high skill; smaller gains; needs precise stimulus
records.programming_priorities: Specialisation, carefully managed volume/intensity, lift-specific practice, fatigue tracking, blocks
records.avoid: Copying elite programmes without matching capacity or context

records.typical_characteristics: Previously trained but detrained after a break
records.programming_priorities: Rebuild frequency and volume gradually; start below remembered loads; reassess skill and tolerance
records.avoid: Resuming old peak loads or full previous volume immediately
